        for key,value in d.items():
            assert type(value) is int and value>=0,(name,key,value)
        assert d['upgrades']==x['upgrades']
        assert d['foreign_machine_upgrades']<=d['imported_machine_upgrades']<=d['machine_required_upgrades']<=d['upgrades']
        assert d['unique_foreign_machines_development']<=d['foreign_machine_upgrades']
        assert d['unique_imported_machines_development']<=d['imported_machine_upgrades']
        assert d['used_output_upgrades']<=d['productive_upgrades']<=d['upgrades']
        assert d['foreign_machine_used_output_upgrades']<=d['foreign_machine_productive_upgrades']<=d['foreign_machine_upgrades']
        assert d['foreign_machine_export_used_units']<=d['foreign_machine_output_used_units']<=d['foreign_machine_output_units']
        assert d['bought_high_machine_developed_unique']<=d['bought_high_machine_used_unique']<=d['bought_high_machine_unique']<=d['bought_high_machines']
        assert d['foreign_produced_high_bought_unique']<=d['bought_high_machine_unique']
        assert d['high_machine_useful_exports']<=d['high_machine_used']<=d['high_machine_produced']
        assert d['high_machine_unused_stock']<=d['high_machine_ending_stock']
        for good in ('machine','electronics'):
            assert d[f'g3_{good}_used']<=d[f'g3_{good}_output']<=x['produced'][good]
        if name in NAMES:
            assert math.isclose(x['score'],x['economic']+x['industry']+x['trade']+x['happy']/4,abs_tol=1e-9)
        else:
            assert x['score'] is None and x['industry'] is None and x['economic'] is None
    assert set(world['development'])==set(DEVELOPMENT_METRICS)
    for key in DEVELOPMENT_METRICS:
        assert world['development'][key]==sum(x['development'][key] for x in result['countries'].values()),('world sum',key)
    d=world['development']
    assert d['bought_high_machines']==d['sold_high_machines']
    assert d['high_machine_purchase_cash']==d['high_machine_sales_cash']
    assert d['g3_machine_output']==sum(x['machine_produced_by_gen']['3'] for x in result['countries'].values())
    return result


def validate_development_records(game,result):
    """Cross-check summaries against authoritative actions and physical UID paths.

    This runs in every formal game; persisted full trace reconstruction is still
    limited to the 24 explicitly selected representative games.
    """
    events=game.development_log
    by_action={(e['round'],e['country'],e['industry'],e['to_level']):e for e in events}
    expected={(r,name,g,level) for name,c in game.cs.items() for r,g,level in c.upgrade_rounds}
    assert len(events)==len(by_action) and set(by_action)==expected
    assert sum(e['cash_cost'] for e in events)==game.sunk
    for name,c in game.cs.items():
        assert sum(e['cash_cost'] for e in events if e['country']==name)==c.investment
    all_output=[i for row in game.development_output_log for i in row['ids']]
    assert len(all_output)==len(set(all_output))
    assert set(all_output)=={i for i,u in game.units.items() if u.born>0}
    uses={(e['round'],e['country'],e['uid'],e['purpose']):e for e in game.development_use_log}
    assert len(uses)==len(game.development_use_log) and set(uses)==game.use_episodes
    raw_development={e['uid']:e for e in game.raw_use_log if e['purpose']=='development'}
    ore_ids=[i for event in events for i in event['ore_ids']]
    assert len(ore_ids)==len(set(ore_ids)) and set(ore_ids)==set(raw_development)
    for event in events:
        for uid in event['ore_ids']:
            raw=raw_development[uid]
            assert (raw['round'],raw['country'],raw['good'])==(event['round'],event['country'],'ore')
        machine=event['machine']
        if machine:
            assert uses[(event['round'],event['country'],machine['uid'],'development')]==machine
            assert machine['generation']>=event['machine_min_gen']
            idx=machine['import_transaction']
            if idx is not None:
                assert type(idx) is int and 0<=idx<len(game.transactions)
                tx=game.transactions[idx]
                assert tx['round']<=event['round']
                assert any(leg['buyer']==event['country'] and machine['uid'] in leg['ids'] for leg in tx['legs'])
    for row in game.development_output_log:
        prior=[e for e in events if e['country']==row['country'] and e['industry']==row['industry'] and e['round']<row['round']]
        expected_id=prior[-1]['event_id'] if prior else None
        assert row['development_event_id']==expected_id
    chains=game.development_chains()
    used_chains=[i for e in chains for i in e['output_ids']]
    assert len(used_chains)==len(set(used_chains))
    for chain in chains:
        eid=chain['event_id']
        ids={i for row in game.development_output_log if row['development_event_id']==eid and row['funded'] for i in row['ids']}
        assert set(chain['output_ids'])==ids
        assert set(chain['used_output_ids'])=={i for i in ids if game.units[i].used}
        assert set(chain['foreign_used_output_ids'])=={i for i in ids if game.foreign_uses.get(i)}
    for name,x in result['countries'].items():
        own=[e for e in chains if e['country']==name]
        d=x['development']
        assert d['machine_required_upgrades']==sum(e['machine'] is not None for e in own)
        assert d['productive_upgrades']==sum(bool(e['output_ids']) for e in own)
        assert d['used_output_upgrades']==sum(bool(e['used_output_ids']) for e in own)
        assert d['foreign_machine_upgrades']==sum(e['foreign_machine'] for e in own)
        assert d['unique_foreign_machines_development']==len({e['machine']['uid'] for e in own if e['foreign_machine']})


def run_one(task):
    phase,mode,seed,focal,style=task
    game=Game(seed,variant=mode,focal=focal,style='normal' if style=='no_trade' else style,trade_enabled=style!='no_trade')
    result=normalize_and_validate(game.run())
    assert result['world']['development_policy']==asdict(MODES[mode])
    for key in ('offer_price_mismatches','listing_plan_violations','protected_offer_violations','uncovered_investments'):
        assert result['world'][key]==0,(mode,seed,focal,style,key)
    if style in REFUSAL_STYLES:
        actor=result['countries'][focal]
        for good in REFUSAL_STYLES[style]:
            assert actor['import_goods'][good]==actor['purchase_by_good'][good]==actor['raw_use'][good]['imported_used']==0
    if style in MACHINE_REFUSALS:
        grade=MACHINE_REFUSALS[style]
        assert all(not (leg['buyer']==focal and any(game.units[i].good=='machine' and game.units[i].gen>=grade for i in leg['ids']))
                   for tx in game.transactions for leg in tx['legs'])
        assert result['countries'][focal]['development']['bought_high_machines']==0
    if style=='idle':
        actor=result['countries'][focal]
        assert actor['imports']==actor['exports']==actor['investment']==0
    if style=='no_trade':assert result['world']['transactions']==0
    validate_raw_ledger(game,result)
    validate_development_records(game,result)
    record={'phase':phase,'mode':mode,'seed':seed,'focal':focal,'style':style,**result}
    ledger=game.cash_ledger if phase=='main' else None
    raw_ledger=game.raw_round_ledger if phase=='main' else None
    trace={**game.trace(),**{key:record[key] for key in ('phase','mode','seed','focal','style')}} if representative(task) else None
    return record,ledger,raw_ledger,trace


def summarize(rows,metadata):
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:groups[(row['phase'],row['mode'],row['focal'],row['style'])].append(row)
    experiments={':'.join(map(str,key)):grouped(group) for key,group in groups.items()}
    pairs={}
    for a,b in MAIN_PAIRS:
        pairs[f'main:{a}->{b}']=pair(groups[('main',a,None,'normal')],groups[('main',b,None,'normal')])
    for mode in STRESS_MODES:
        control=groups[('stress',mode,None,'normal')]
        for focal,style in STRESS_SCENARIOS:
            if style=='normal':continue
            suffix='no_trade' if style=='no_trade' else f'{focal}:{style}'
            pairs[f'stress:{mode}:{suffix}']=pair(control,groups[('stress',mode,focal,style)],focal)
    for a,b in STRESS_PAIRS:
        for focal,style in STRESS_SCENARIOS:
            pairs[f'stress:{a}->{b}:{focal}:{style}']=pair(groups[('stress',a,focal,style)],groups[('stress',b,focal,style)],focal)
    return {'metadata':metadata,'experiments':experiments,'paired':pairs}


def run_tests(output):
    before=hashes(SOURCE_FILES);test_hashes=hashes(TEST_FILES)
    start=time.monotonic()
    suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames([Path(name).stem for name in TEST_FILES])

              'test_sha256':test_hashes,'economic_source_sha256':hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES),
              'validation_source_sha256':before,'source_unchanged':before==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),
              'tests_unchanged':test_hashes==hashes(TEST_FILES)}
    (output/'tests_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    assert manifest['passed'] and manifest['test_count']>230 and not manifest['skipped'],manifest
    assert manifest['source_unchanged'] and manifest['tests_unchanged']
    print(f'TESTS {manifest["test_count"]} passed, {manifest["elapsed_seconds"]:.2f}s',flush=True)
    return manifest


def verified_test_manifest(output):
    path=output/'tests_manifest.json'
    if not path.exists():return run_tests(output)
    manifest=json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert manifest['passed'] and manifest['test_count']>230 and manifest['inherited_tests']==230

    assert manifest['validation_source_sha256']==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),'runner changed after recorded verification'

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()

            'main_seed_range':[MAIN_START,MAIN_START+args.n-1],
            'stress_seed_range':[STRESS_START,STRESS_START+args.stress_n-1],
            'representative_traces':sum(representative(t) for t in tasks),'executed_games':0},ensure_ascii=False));return
    output=args.output_dir.resolve();output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name in ('pre_run_plan.json','run_manifest.json','summary.json','runs.jsonl.gz','runs.partial.jsonl.gz',

    if args.tests_only:

    config={'main_seed_range':[MAIN_START,MAIN_START+args.n-1],

def scenario(focal=None, style='normal', behaviors=()):
    """Hashable stable condition; secondary overrides are explicit, not hidden."""
    behaviors = tuple(sorted(behaviors))
    label = f'{focal}:{style}'+''.join(f'+{n}:{s}' for n,s in behaviors)
    return label,focal,style,behaviors


MAIN_SCENARIOS = (scenario(),)+tuple(scenario(n,s) for n in NAMES for s in ('cheap','minimum','idle'))

             for phase,start,count,conditions in (('main',MAIN_START,n,MAIN_SCENARIOS),

             for condition in conditions for seed in range(start,start+count)]

def close(actual,expected,label):

def normalize_and_validate(result):
    result = normalize_routing(result)
    world = result['world']
    assert world['routing_variant']=='market_first'
    assert world['routing_policy']==asdict(ROUTING_MODES['market_first'])
    config = world['evaluation_config']
    assert config['baseline']=='v10 market_first'
    assert config['legal_public_minimum']==1
    assert config['scoring_modes']==list(SCORING_MODES)
    assert config['original_scores_unchanged'] and config['shadow_scores_do_not_affect_actions'] and config['public_prices_only']
    for name,country in result['countries'].items():
        diagnostic = country['evaluation']
        assert set(diagnostic)==set(DIAGNOSTICS)|{'scores'},(name,'evaluation diagnostic schema')
        for key in DIAGNOSTICS:
            value = diagnostic[key]
            assert type(value) is int,(name,key,value)
            assert value>=0 or key=='cash_trade_balance',(name,key,value)
        assert diagnostic['public_minimum_violations']==0
        assert diagnostic['cash_trade_balance']==country['revenue']-country['purchases']
        assert diagnostic['unique_foreign_development_machines']<=diagnostic['foreign_machine_uses']<=diagnostic['successful_machine_uses']<=diagnostic['ready_opportunities']<=diagnostic['machine_attempts']<=7
        assert diagnostic['ready_unfulfilled']<=diagnostic['ready_opportunities']
        assert diagnostic['existing_equipment_overlap']<=diagnostic['foreign_machine_uses']
        views = diagnostic['scores']
        assert set(views)==set(SCORING_MODES)
        for mode,v in views.items():
            assert set(v)==set(SCORE_KEYS),(name,mode,'score schema')
            for key in SCORE_COUNTS:assert type(v[key]) is int and v[key]>=0,(name,mode,key,v[key])
            for key,value in v.items():
                if value is None:assert key=='score' and name not in NAMES
                else:assert type(value) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(value),(name,mode,key,value)
            assert 0<=v['external_fulfilled']<=v['external_need']
            assert 0<=v['added_fulfilled']<=v['added_external']<=v['added_needed']<=7
            assert 0<=v['fulfilled_rounds']<=v['external_rounds']<=9
            assert 0<=v['coverage']<=1
            assert 0<=v['trade']<=25+1e-9 and 0<=v['imports_part']<=8 and 0<=v['effects_import_part']<=4
            close(v['external_need'],country['external_need']+v['added_external'],(name,mode,'need'))
            close(v['external_fulfilled'],country['external_fulfilled']+v['added_fulfilled'],(name,mode,'fulfilled'))
            close(v['trade']-country['trade'],v['trade_delta'],(name,mode,'trade delta'))
            close(v['coverage'],v['external_fulfilled']/v['external_need'] if v['external_need'] else 0,(name,mode,'coverage'))
            if name in NAMES:
                assert 0<=v['score']<=100+1e-9
                close(v['score'],country['score']+v['trade_delta'],(name,mode,'total'))
            else:assert v['score'] is None
            if mode=='legacy':
                assert v['trade']==country['trade'] and v['score']==country['score']
                assert v['trade_delta']==v['added_needed']==v['added_external']==v['added_fulfilled']==v['skipped_existing_credit']==0
            elif mode!='ready_once':assert v['skipped_existing_credit']==0
        assert views['ready_once']['added_needed']+views['ready_once']['skipped_existing_credit']==views['ready']['added_needed']
        assert views['ready_once']['added_external']+views['ready_once']['skipped_existing_credit']==views['ready']['added_external']
        assert views['ready_once']['added_fulfilled']+views['ready_once']['skipped_existing_credit']==views['ready']['added_fulfilled']
    assert set(world['evaluation'])==set(DIAGNOSTICS)
    for key in DIAGNOSTICS:
        assert world['evaluation'][key]==sum(x['evaluation'][key] for x in result['countries'].values()),('world evaluation sum',key)
    assert world['evaluation']['cash_trade_balance']==0
    return result


def validate_evaluation_records(game,result):

        machine = a['machine_used']
        assert a['fulfilled']==int(bool(a['external'] and machine and machine['origin']!=a['country'] and machine['import_transaction'] is not None))
        assert a['already_credited']==bool(a['fulfilled'] and machine['uid'] in a['prior_credited_equipment_ids'])
        if a['successful']:
            event = game.development_log[a['event_id']]
            assert (event['round'],event['country'],event['industry'],event['to_level'])==(a['round'],a['country'],a['goal'],a['target_level'])
            assert event['cash_cost']==a['cash_cost']
            assert event['machine']==machine
        else:assert a['event_id'] is None and machine is None
        if machine:
            assert ready and machine['uid'] in a['free_qualified_ids']
        elif ready:assert not a['free_qualified_ids']
        for uid in a['prior_credited_equipment_ids']:
            assert any(row['round']==a['round'] and row['country']==a['country'] and row['good']=='machine' and
                       row['purpose'].startswith('equipment:') and row['fulfilled'] and uid in row['used_ids']
                       for row in game.needs_ledger)
        for mode in SCORING_MODES[1:]:

            if include:
                expected_rows[mode].append({'round':a['round'],'country':a['country'],'good':'machine',
                    'purpose':'development','needed':1,'external':a['external'],'fulfilled':a['fulfilled'],
                    'used_ids':[machine['uid']] if machine else [],'min_gen':a['machine_min_gen'],
                    'goal':a['goal'],'target_level':a['target_level'],'event_id':a['event_id']})
    for mode in SCORING_MODES:assert game.evaluation_rows(mode)==expected_rows[mode]
    for name,country in result['countries'].items():
        a = [r for r in attempts if r['country']==name and r['machine_min_gen']]
        diag = country['evaluation']

        assert diag['successful_machine_uses']==sum(bool(r['machine_used']) for r in a)
        foreign = [r['machine_used'] for r in a if r['machine_used'] and r['machine_used']['origin']!=name and r['machine_used']['import_transaction'] is not None]
        assert diag['foreign_machine_uses']==len(foreign)
        assert diag['unique_foreign_development_machines']==len({u['uid'] for u in foreign})
        assert diag['ready_unfulfilled']==sum(r['ready'] and r['external'] and not r['fulfilled'] for r in a)
        for label in ('cash','household','raw'):assert diag['blocked_'+label]==sum(label in r['blockers'] for r in a)
        assert diag['existing_equipment_overlap']==sum(r['already_credited'] for r in a)
        if game.behaviors.get(name) in MINIMUM_BEHAVIORS:
            assert all(row['prices']==[game.opt.price_tick] for row in game.offer_history if row['country']==name)
            assert all(row['actual_prices']==[game.opt.price_tick] and row['recommendation']['price']==game.opt.price_tick

            imports = 8*filled/ext if ext else 0;effects = 4*len(fr)/len(er) if er else 0

def run_one(task):
    phase,seed,sid,focal,style,overrides = task
    game = Game(seed,focal=focal,style='normal' if style=='no_trade' else style,
                trade_enabled=style!='no_trade',behaviors=dict(overrides))
    result = normalize_and_validate(game.run())
    for key in ('offer_price_mismatches','listing_plan_violations','protected_offer_violations','uncovered_investments'):
        assert result['world'][key]==0,(seed,sid,key)
    for name,behavior in game.behaviors.items():
        actor = result['countries'][name]
        if behavior=='idle':assert actor['imports']==actor['exports']==actor['investment']==actor['routing']['routes_started']==0
        if behavior=='minimum_passive':assert actor['investment']==actor['routing']['routes_started']==0
    if style=='no_trade':assert result['world']['transactions']==0
    if style=='no_raw':
        actor = result['countries'][focal]
        for good in ('ore','fuel'):assert actor['import_goods'][good]==actor['purchase_by_good'][good]==actor['raw_use'][good]['imported_used']==0
    if style=='no_high_machine':
        assert all(not(leg['buyer']==focal and any(game.units[i].good=='machine' and game.units[i].gen>=2 for i in leg['ids']))
                   for tx in game.transactions for leg in tx['legs'])
    validate_raw_ledger(game,result)
    validate_development_records(game,result)
    validate_routing_records(game,result)
    validate_evaluation_records(game,result)
    identity = {'phase':phase,'mode':'market_first','scenario':sid,'seed':seed,'focal':focal,'style':style,
                'behaviors':dict(game.behaviors)}
    record = {**identity,**result}
    cash = {**identity,'rows':game.cash_ledger} if phase=='main' else None
    raw = {**identity,'rows':game.raw_round_ledger} if phase=='main' else None
    trace = {**game.trace(),**identity} if representative(task) else None
    return record,cash,raw,trace


def summarize(rows,metadata):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:groups[(row['phase'],row['scenario'])].append(row)
    experiments = {f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}':grouped(group) for (phase,sid),group in groups.items()}
    pairs = {}
    for phase,conditions in (('main',MAIN_SCENARIOS),('stress',STRESS_SCENARIOS)):
        control = groups[(phase,'None:normal')]
        for sid,focal,style,overrides in conditions:
            if sid=='None:normal':continue
            pairs[f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}'] = pair(control,groups[(phase,sid)],focal)
    for name in NAMES:
        pairs[f'main:market_first:{name}:cheap->minimum'] = pair(
            groups[('main',f'{name}:cheap')],groups[('main',f'{name}:minimum')],name)
    for name in ('Technia','Novia'):
        sid = f'Mechania:idle+{name}:minimum'
        pairs[f'stress:market_first:Mechania:idle->{sid}'] = pair(
            groups[('stress','Mechania:idle')],groups[('stress',sid)],name)
    return {'metadata':metadata,'experiments':experiments,'paired':pairs}


def run_tests(output):
    before = hashes(SOURCE_FILES);test_hashes = hashes(TEST_FILES);started = time.monotonic()
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames([Path(n).stem for n in TEST_FILES])
    with (output/'tests.log').open('w') as stream:
        result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream,verbosity=2).run(suite)
    manifest = {'passed':result.wasSuccessful(),'test_count':result.testsRun,'inherited_tests':INHERITED_TESTS,
        'new_tests':result.testsRun-INHERITED_TESTS,'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),
        'skipped':len(result.skipped),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,
        'test_sha256':test_hashes,'economic_source_sha256':hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES),'validation_source_sha256':before,
        'source_unchanged':before==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),'tests_unchanged':test_hashes==hashes(TEST_FILES)}
    (output/'tests_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    assert manifest['passed'] and manifest['test_count']>INHERITED_TESTS and not manifest['skipped'],manifest
    assert manifest['source_unchanged'] and manifest['tests_unchanged']
    print(f'TESTS {manifest["test_count"]} passed, {manifest["elapsed_seconds"]:.2f}s',flush=True)
    return manifest


def verified_test_manifest(output):
    path = output/'tests_manifest.json'
    if not path.exists():return run_tests(output)
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert manifest['passed'] and manifest['test_count']>INHERITED_TESTS and manifest['inherited_tests']==INHERITED_TESTS
    assert manifest['failures']==manifest['errors']==manifest['skipped']==0
    assert manifest['test_sha256']==hashes(TEST_FILES),'tests changed after recorded verification'
    assert manifest['economic_source_sha256']==hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES),'economic code changed after recorded verification'
    assert manifest['validation_source_sha256']==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),'runner changed after recorded verification'
    assert manifest['source_unchanged'] and manifest['tests_unchanged']
    return manifest


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--n',type=int,default=200);parser.add_argument('--stress-n',type=int,default=30)

def digest(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def hashes(files):return {name:digest(ROOT/name) for name in files}

def validate_invest_attempts(game,result):
    """v11 snapshot contracts with the inherited invest household exception.

    The v11 validator assumes ordinary household guards. This independent
    branch verifies those same evidence links while explicitly allowing only
    style='invest' to bypass the ordinary household/reserve policy.
    """
    rows=game.evaluation_attempts
    assert len(rows)==81 and len(game.evaluation_index)==81
    assert {(a['round'],a['country']) for a in rows}=={(r,n) for r in range(1,10) for n in game.cs}
    for i,a in enumerate(rows):
        assert game.evaluation_index[(a['round'],a['country'])]==i
        legal=bool(1<=a['round']<=7 and a['style'] not in ('idle','trade') and a['goal'] and
            a['levels'].get(a['goal'],0)<4 and (a['goal'] in a['levels'] or (a['goal']==a['expand'] and a['round']>=3)))
        assert a['legal']==legal
        assert a['cash_ok']==(a['cash']>=a['cash_cost']+a['reserve'])
        if a['style']=='invest':assert a['reserve']==0
        assert a['household_ok']==(a['style']=='invest' or (a['food_met'] and a['living_free']>=a['living_needed']))
        assert a['raw_ok']==all(a['raw_free'].get(g,0)>=q for g,q in a['raw_required'].items())
        ready=bool(a['cached'] and legal and a['machine_min_gen'] and a['cash_ok'] and a['household_ok'] and a['raw_ok'])
        assert a['ready']==ready
        units=a['qualified_units']
        assert [u['uid'] for u in units]==a['qualified_ids']
        assert len(a['qualified_ids'])==len(set(a['qualified_ids']))
        assert [u['uid'] for u in units if u['order'] is None]==a['free_qualified_ids']
        assert [u['uid'] for u in units if u['origin']==a['country']]==a['own_qualified_ids']
        for u in units:
            actual=game.units[u['uid']]
            assert actual.good=='machine' and actual.gen==u['generation']>=a['machine_min_gen'] and actual.origin==u['origin']
            if u['import_transaction'] is not None:
                tx=game.transactions[u['import_transaction']]
                assert tx['round']<=a['round']
                assert any(leg['buyer']==a['country'] and u['uid'] in leg['ids'] for leg in tx['legs'])
        machine=a['machine_used']
        assert a['external']==int(bool(a['machine_min_gen']) and not a['own_qualified_ids'])
        assert a['fulfilled']==int(bool(a['external'] and machine and machine['origin']!=a['country'] and machine['import_transaction'] is not None))
        assert a['already_credited']==bool(a['fulfilled'] and machine['uid'] in a['prior_credited_equipment_ids'])
        if a['successful']:
            e=game.development_log[a['event_id']]
            assert (e['round'],e['country'],e['industry'],e['to_level'])==(a['round'],a['country'],a['goal'],a['target_level'])
            assert e['cash_cost']==a['cash_cost'] and e['machine']==machine
        else:assert a['event_id'] is None and machine is None
        if machine:assert ready and machine['uid'] in a['free_qualified_ids']
        elif ready:assert not a['free_qualified_ids']
        for uid in a['prior_credited_equipment_ids']:
            assert any(r['round']==a['round'] and r['country']==a['country'] and r['good']=='machine' and
                r['purpose'].startswith('equipment:') and r['fulfilled'] and uid in r['used_ids'] for r in game.needs_ledger)
    for name,c in result['countries'].items():
        attempts=[a for a in rows if a['country']==name and a['machine_min_gen']]
        d=c['evaluation']
        assert d['machine_attempts']==len(attempts)
        assert d['ready_opportunities']==sum(a['ready'] for a in attempts)
        assert d['successful_machine_uses']==sum(bool(a['machine_used']) for a in attempts)
        foreign=[a['machine_used'] for a in attempts if a['machine_used'] and a['machine_used']['origin']!=name and a['machine_used']['import_transaction'] is not None]
        assert d['foreign_machine_uses']==len(foreign)
        assert d['unique_foreign_development_machines']==len({u['uid'] for u in foreign})
        assert d['ready_unfulfilled']==sum(a['ready'] and a['external'] and not a['fulfilled'] for a in attempts)
        for label in ('cash','household','raw'):assert d['blocked_'+label]==sum(label in a['blockers'] for a in attempts)
        for mode,v in d['scores'].items():
            expected=[]
            if mode!='legacy':
                expected=[a for a in attempts if (a['successful'] if mode=='success_only' else a['ready'])
                          and not(mode=='ready_once' and a['already_credited'])]
            actual=[r for r in game.evaluation_rows(mode) if r['country']==name]

def validate_metrics(result):
    for name,c in result['countries'].items():
        m=c['growth_metrics']
        assert set(m)==set(METRIC_KEYS),(name,'growth metric schema')
        assert all(type(v) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in m.values())

        close(m['stock_value'],m['unused_stock_value']+m['used_stock_value'],(name,'stock valuation'))
        assert m['initial_capacity']>0 and m['reserve_target']>0
        close(m['capacity_growth'],(m['final_capacity']-m['initial_capacity'])/m['initial_capacity'],(name,'capacity'))

        assert m['used_units']==c['all_goods_unique_used']==sum(c['use_by_good'].values())

def run_one(task):
    phase,seed,sid,focal,style,overrides=task
    game=Game(seed,focal=focal,style='normal' if style=='no_trade' else style,
              trade_enabled=style!='no_trade',behaviors=dict(overrides))
    result=normalize_v11(game.run())
    for key in ('offer_price_mismatches','listing_plan_violations','protected_offer_violations','uncovered_investments'):
        assert result['world'][key]==0,(phase,seed,sid,key)
    for name,behavior in game.behaviors.items():
        c=result['countries'][name]
        if behavior=='idle':assert c['imports']==c['exports']==c['investment']==c['routing']['routes_started']==0
        if behavior in ('trade','minimum_passive'):assert c['investment']==c['routing']['routes_started']==0
    if style=='no_trade':assert result['world']['transactions']==0
    validate_raw_ledger(game,result);validate_development_records(game,result);validate_routing_records(game,result)
    if 'invest' in game.behaviors.values():validate_invest_attempts(game,result)
    else:validate_evaluation_records(game,result)
    metrics=extract_metrics(game,result)
    for name,m in metrics.items():result['countries'][name]['growth_metrics']=m
    validate_metrics(result)
    identity={'phase':phase,'mode':'market_first','scenario':sid,'seed':seed,'focal':focal,'style':style,'behaviors':dict(game.behaviors)}
    record={**identity,**result}
    cash={**identity,'rows':game.cash_ledger} if phase=='holdout' else None
    raw={**identity,'rows':game.raw_round_ledger} if phase=='holdout' else None
    trace={**game.trace(),**identity,'result':record} if representative(task) else None

            'minimum means public1G asks; direct negotiation and barter keep their existing rules',

def run_tests(output):
    before=hashes(SOURCE_FILES);test_hashes=hashes(TEST_FILES);inherited=inherited_hashes();started=time.monotonic()
    suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames([Path(n).stem for n in TEST_FILES])
    with (output/'tests.log').open('w') as stream:result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream,verbosity=2).run(suite)
    m={'passed':result.wasSuccessful(),'test_count':result.testsRun,'inherited_tests':INHERITED_TESTS,
        'new_tests':result.testsRun-INHERITED_TESTS,'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'skipped':len(result.skipped),
        'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'test_sha256':test_hashes,'economic_source_sha256':hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES),
        'validation_source_sha256':before,'inherited_source_sha256':inherited,'source_unchanged':before==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),
        'tests_unchanged':test_hashes==hashes(TEST_FILES),'inherited_unchanged':inherited==inherited_hashes()}
    write_json(output/'tests_manifest.json',m)
    assert m['passed'] and m['test_count']>INHERITED_TESTS and m['failures']==m['errors']==m['skipped']==0,m
    assert m['source_unchanged'] and m['tests_unchanged'] and m['inherited_unchanged']
    print(f'TESTS {m["test_count"]} passed, {m["elapsed_seconds"]:.2f}s',flush=True)
    return m


def verified_tests(output):
    path=output/'tests_manifest.json'
    if not path.exists():return run_tests(output)
    m=read_json(path)
    assert m['passed'] and m['test_count']>INHERITED_TESTS and m['inherited_tests']==INHERITED_TESTS
    assert m['failures']==m['errors']==m['skipped']==0
    assert m['test_sha256']==hashes(TEST_FILES) and m['validation_source_sha256']==hashes(SOURCE_FILES)
    assert m['economic_source_sha256']==hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES)
    assert m['inherited_source_sha256']==inherited_hashes()
    assert m['source_unchanged'] and m['tests_unchanged'] and m['inherited_unchanged']
    return m


def preserve_absent(output,names):
    for name in names:
        if (output/name).exists():raise FileExistsError(f'Preserve existing validation artifacts: {output/name}')


def read_rows(path):
    with gzip.open(path,'rt') as stream:return [json.loads(line) for line in stream]


def assert_schedule(rows,phases):
    expected={(phase,seed,sid,focal,style,overrides) for phase,seed,sid,focal,style,overrides in build_tasks(phases)}
    actual=set()
    for r in rows:
        focal=r['focal'];style=r['style'];behaviors=dict(r['behaviors'])
        if focal is not None:
            assert behaviors.pop(focal)==style
        key=(r['phase'],r['seed'],r['scenario'],focal,style,tuple(sorted(behaviors.items())))
        assert key not in actual and r['mode']=='market_first'
        actual.add(key)
    assert actual==expected and len(rows)==len(expected)


def select_policies(scored_calibration):
    """Select among three fixed policies using calibration only, never holdout."""
    if not scored_calibration or any(r['phase']!='calibration' for r in scored_calibration):
        raise ValueError('policy selection requires calibration records only')
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    identities=set()
    for r in scored_calibration:
        identity=r['scenario'],r['seed']
        if identity in identities:raise ValueError('duplicate calibration policy record')
        identities.add(identity);groups[r['scenario']].append(r)
    seeds={r['seed'] for r in groups['None:normal']}
    expected={'None:normal'}|{f'{n}:{s}' for n in NAMES for s in ('invest','trade')}
    if len(seeds)<2 or set(identities)!={(sid,seed) for sid in expected for seed in seeds}:
        raise ValueError('policy selection requires the paired thirteen calibration conditions')
    selection={}
    for view in VIEWS:
        selection[view]={}
        for name in NAMES:
            values={style:statistics.mean(r['countries'][name]['growth_evaluation'][view]['score']
                for r in groups['None:normal' if style=='normal' else f'{name}:{style}'])
                for style in ('normal','invest','trade')}
            best=max(values.values());chosen=next(style for style in ('normal','invest','trade') if values[style]>=best-1e-9)
            selection[view][name]={'policy':chosen,'scenario':'None:normal' if chosen=='normal' else f'{name}:{chosen}',
                'calibration_mean_score':values[chosen],'calibration_n':len(seeds),'policy_means':values}
    return {'schema':'v12-policy-selection-1','source':'calibration_only',
        'criterion':'own mean candidate total score','tie_order':['normal','invest','trade'],'tie_tolerance':1e-9,
        'calibration_seeds':sorted(seeds),'selections':selection,
        'scope':'Each selected policy belongs to a separate focal-country world; no jointly optimized world was simulated.'}

    names=('pre_run_plan.json','calibration_manifest.json','goals.json','frozen_selection.json','freeze_manifest.json',
        'calibration_runs.jsonl.gz','calibration_runs.partial.jsonl.gz','calibration_traces.json.gz')
    preserve_absent(output,names);tests=verified_tests(output)
    sources=hashes(SOURCE_FILES);test_hashes=hashes(TEST_FILES);inherited=inherited_hashes()
    plan=protocol();write_json(output/'pre_run_plan.json',plan)
    started=time.monotonic();rows=[];traces={};tasks=build_tasks(('calibration',))
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool,gzip.open(output/'calibration_runs.partial.jsonl.gz','wt') as stream:
        for i,(record,cash,raw,trace) in enumerate(pool.map(run_one,tasks,chunksize=4),1):
            assert cash is None and raw is None
            rows.append(record);stream.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
            if trace is not None:traces[trace_key(record)]=trace
            if i%130==0:print(f'CALIBRATION {i}/780 complete; {time.monotonic()-started:.1f}s',flush=True)
    assert_schedule(rows,('calibration',))
    goals=make_goals(rows);validate_goals(goals)
    assert goals['calibration']['seeds']==list(range(90000,90060)) and goals['calibration']['samples_per_country']==180
    assert sources==hashes(SOURCE_FILES) and test_hashes==hashes(TEST_FILES) and inherited==inherited_hashes()
    assert len(traces)==13
    (output/'calibration_runs.partial.jsonl.gz').replace(output/'calibration_runs.jsonl.gz')

    write_json(output/'goals.json',goals)
    selection=select_policies([score_record(r,goals) for r in rows])

    manifest={'phase':'calibration','completed_games':780,'calibration_games':780,'holdout_games':0,'stress_games':0,
        'verification_calls':sum(r['world']['verify_calls'] for r in rows),'verification_failures':0,
        'representative_traces':13,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'source_unchanged':True,'tests_completed':tests['test_count'],
        'source_sha256':sources,'test_sha256':test_hashes,'inherited_source_sha256':inherited,
        'protocol_sha256':digest(output/'pre_run_plan.json'),'goals_sha256':digest(output/'goals.json'),
        'selection_sha256':digest(output/'frozen_selection.json'),
        'calibration_runs_sha256':digest(output/'calibration_runs.jsonl.gz'),'calibration_traces_sha256':digest(output/'calibration_traces.json.gz'),
        'tests_manifest_sha256':digest(output/'tests_manifest.json'),'completed_at':now()}
    write_json(output/'calibration_manifest.json',manifest)
    freeze={'schema':'v12-growth-freeze-1','created_at':now(),'holdout_not_executed':True,
        'protocol_sha256':manifest['protocol_sha256'],'goals_sha256':manifest['goals_sha256'],
        'selection_sha256':manifest['selection_sha256'],
        'calibration_runs_sha256':manifest['calibration_runs_sha256'],'calibration_traces_sha256':manifest['calibration_traces_sha256'],
        'calibration_manifest_sha256':digest(output/'calibration_manifest.json'),'source_sha256':sources,
        'test_sha256':test_hashes,'inherited_source_sha256':inherited,'tests_manifest_sha256':manifest['tests_manifest_sha256'],
        'calibration_games':780,'holdout_games_planned':3100,'stress_games_planned':300}

    print('FREEZE_SHA256 '+digest(output/'freeze_manifest.json'),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps({'economic':goals['economic'],'industrial':goals['industrial']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)


def verify_freeze(output,approved):
    path=output/'freeze_manifest.json'
    if not approved or approved!=digest(path):raise ValueError('Explicitly reviewed freeze SHA256 is required')
    freeze=read_json(path)
    assert freeze['schema']=='v12-growth-freeze-1' and freeze['holdout_not_executed']
    files={'protocol_sha256':'pre_run_plan.json','goals_sha256':'goals.json',
        'selection_sha256':'frozen_selection.json',
        'calibration_runs_sha256':'calibration_runs.jsonl.gz','calibration_traces_sha256':'calibration_traces.json.gz',
        'calibration_manifest_sha256':'calibration_manifest.json','tests_manifest_sha256':'tests_manifest.json'}
    for key,name in files.items():assert freeze[key]==digest(output/name),(key,'changed after target freeze')
    assert read_json(output/'pre_run_plan.json')==protocol(),'Protocol changed after calibration'
    assert freeze['source_sha256']==hashes(SOURCE_FILES),'Source changed after calibration'
    assert freeze['test_sha256']==hashes(TEST_FILES),'Tests changed after calibration'
    assert freeze['inherited_source_sha256']==inherited_hashes()
    tests=verified_tests(output);goals=read_json(output/'goals.json');validate_goals(goals)
    rows=read_rows(output/'calibration_runs.jsonl.gz');assert_schedule(rows,('calibration',))
    assert make_goals(rows)==goals,'Frozen target values differ from declared calibration records'
    assert select_policies([score_record(r,goals) for r in rows])==read_json(output/'frozen_selection.json')
    return freeze,goals,rows,tests


def summarize(rows,metadata):
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:groups[(r['phase'],r['scenario'])].append(r)
    experiments={f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}':grouped(group) for (phase,sid),group in groups.items()}
    paired={}
    for phase,conditions in (('calibration',CALIBRATION_SCENARIOS),('holdout',HOLDOUT_SCENARIOS)):
        control=groups[(phase,'None:normal')]
        for sid,focal,style,overrides in conditions:
            if sid!='None:normal':paired[f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}']=pair(control,groups[(phase,sid)],focal)
    for name in ('Technia','Novia'):
        sid=f'Mechania:idle+{name}:minimum'
        paired[f'stress:market_first:Mechania:idle->{sid}']=pair(groups[('stress','Mechania:idle')],groups[('stress',sid)],name)
    diagnostics={};view_pairs={}
    for (phase,sid),group in groups.items():
        key=f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}';diagnostics[key]={};view_pairs[key]={}
        for view in VIEWS:
            scores=[[r['countries'][n]['growth_evaluation'][view] for n in NAMES] for r in group]
            diagnostics[key][view]={
                'original_score_spread':stats([max(v['score'] for v in row)-min(v['score'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
                'original_mean_score':stats([statistics.mean(v['score'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
                'economic_growth_near_cap_share':stats([statistics.mean(v['economic_growth_near_cap'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
                'capacity_near_cap_share':stats([statistics.mean(v['capacity_near_cap'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
                'economic_5pct_sensitivity':stats([statistics.mean(v['economic_5pct_sensitivity'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
                'capacity_5pct_sensitivity':stats([statistics.mean(v['capacity_5pct_sensitivity'] for v in row) for row in scores]),
            }
            if view=='legacy':continue
            d={f'countries.{name}.{field}':stats([r['countries'][name]['growth_evaluation'][view][field]-r['countries'][name]['growth_evaluation']['legacy'][field] for r in group]) for name in NAMES for field in VIEW_DIFFERENCE_KEYS}
            d['world.original_score_spread']=stats([
                (max(r['countries'][n]['growth_evaluation'][view]['score'] for n in NAMES)-min(r['countries'][n]['growth_evaluation'][view]['score'] for n in NAMES))-
                (max(r['countries'][n]['growth_evaluation']['legacy']['score'] for n in NAMES)-min(r['countries'][n]['growth_evaluation']['legacy']['score'] for n in NAMES)) for r in group])
            view_pairs[key]['legacy->'+view]=d
    return {'metadata':metadata,'experiments':experiments,'paired':paired,'growth_diagnostics':diagnostics,'score_view_pairs':view_pairs}


def holdout(output,workers,approved):
    names=('holdout_start.json','run_manifest.json','summary.json','runs.jsonl.gz','runs.partial.jsonl.gz',
        'round_ledgers.jsonl.gz','round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','raw_round_ledgers.jsonl.gz',
        'raw_round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','first_seed_traces.json.gz')
    preserve_absent(output,names)
    freeze,goals,calibration,tests=verify_freeze(output,approved)
    write_json(output/'holdout_start.json',{'started_at':now(),'approved_freeze_sha256':approved,
        'goals_sha256':freeze['goals_sha256'],'protocol_sha256':freeze['protocol_sha256'],
        'selection_sha256':freeze['selection_sha256'],
        'source_sha256':freeze['source_sha256'],'test_sha256':freeze['test_sha256']})
    started=time.monotonic();rows=[];traces={};tasks=build_tasks(('holdout','stress'))
    with gzip.open(output/'calibration_traces.json.gz','rt') as stream:cal_traces=json.load(stream)
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool,gzip.open(output/'runs.partial.jsonl.gz','wt') as runfile, \
         gzip.open(output/'round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','wt') as cashfile,gzip.open(output/'raw_round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','wt') as rawfile:
        for raw_record in calibration:
            scored=score_record(raw_record,goals);validate_scored(scored,goals);rows.append(scored)
            runfile.write(json.dumps(scored,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
            key=trace_key(scored)
            if key in cal_traces:
                trace=cal_traces[key];trace['result']=scored;traces[key]=trace
        for i,(raw_record,cash,raw,trace) in enumerate(pool.map(run_one,tasks,chunksize=4),1):
            scored=score_record(raw_record,goals);validate_scored(scored,goals);rows.append(scored)
            runfile.write(json.dumps(scored,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
            if cash is not None:cashfile.write(json.dumps(cash,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
            if raw is not None:rawfile.write(json.dumps(raw,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
            if trace is not None:trace['result']=scored;traces[trace_key(scored)]=trace
            if i%200==0:print(f'HOLDOUT/STRESS {i}/3400 complete; {time.monotonic()-started:.1f}s',flush=True)
    assert_schedule(rows,('calibration','holdout','stress'))
    assert freeze['source_sha256']==hashes(SOURCE_FILES) and freeze['test_sha256']==hashes(TEST_FILES)
    assert freeze['inherited_source_sha256']==inherited_hashes()
    assert freeze['goals_sha256']==digest(output/'goals.json') and approved==digest(output/'freeze_manifest.json')
    assert freeze['selection_sha256']==digest(output/'frozen_selection.json')
    expected_traces={f'{phase}:market_first:{sid}:{seed}' for phase,seed,sid,focal,style,overrides in build_tasks() if seed==PHASES[phase][0]}
    assert len(traces)==54 and set(traces)==expected_traces
    cal_manifest=read_json(output/'calibration_manifest.json')
    metadata={**protocol(),'completed_games':4180,'calibration_games':780,'holdout_games':3100,'stress_games':300,
        'representative_traces':54,'holdout_cash_ledger_rows':251100,'holdout_raw_ledger_rows':251100,
        'verification_calls':sum(r['world']['verify_calls'] for r in rows),'verification_failures':0,
        'source_unchanged':True,'source_sha256_before':freeze['source_sha256'],'source_sha256_after':hashes(SOURCE_FILES),
        'source_sha256':freeze['source_sha256'],'test_sha256_before':freeze['test_sha256'],'test_sha256_after':hashes(TEST_FILES),
        'inherited_source_sha256':freeze['inherited_source_sha256'],'tests_completed':tests['test_count'],
        'tests_manifest_sha256':freeze['tests_manifest_sha256'],'goals_sha256':freeze['goals_sha256'],
        'selection_sha256':freeze['selection_sha256'],
        'freeze_sha256':approved,'protocol_sha256':freeze['protocol_sha256'],
        'calibration_runs_sha256':freeze['calibration_runs_sha256'],'calibration_manifest_sha256':freeze['calibration_manifest_sha256'],
        'holdout_start_sha256':digest(output/'holdout_start.json'),'calibration_elapsed_seconds':cal_manifest['elapsed_seconds'],
        'holdout_stress_elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'holdout_started_after_freeze':True,
        'test_and_smoke_games_excluded':True,'score_views_are_extra_games':False,'completed_at':now()}
    summary=summarize(rows,metadata)
    for name in ('runs','round_ledgers','raw_round_ledgers'):(output/f'{name}.partial.jsonl.gz').replace(output/f'{name}.jsonl.gz')
    with gzip.open(output/'first_seed_traces.json.gz','wt') as stream:json.dump(traces,stream,ensure_ascii=False)
    write_json(output/'summary.json',summary);write_json(output/'run_manifest.json',metadata)
    print(f'DONE 4180 unique trajectories; {metadata["verification_calls"]} invariant calls; holdout/stress {metadata["holdout_stress_elapsed_seconds"]:.2f}s',flush=True)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--stage',choices=('calibrate','holdout'))
    parser.add_argument('--approve-freeze');parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=4)
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,default=OUT)
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--tests-only',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.workers<1:parser.error('workers must be positive')
    if args.dry_run:
        print(json.dumps({**protocol(),'executed_games':0},ensure_ascii=False));return
    output=args.output_dir.resolve();output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if args.tests_only:run_tests(output);return
    if args.stage is None:parser.error('choose --stage calibrate or --stage holdout')
    if args.stage=='calibrate':calibrate(output,args.workers)
    else:
        if not args.approve_freeze:parser.error('--stage holdout requires --approve-freeze SHA256')
        holdout(output,args.workers,args.approve_freeze)

RAW_WORLD_SUMS=('first_two_food_short','first_two_production_failures','first_round_production_failures',
    'machine_free_basic','machine_g2','machine_g3','electronics_g2','electronics_g3')
RAW_WORLD_MAPS=('starter_raw','initial_raw_left','raw_importing','raw_import_rounds','raw_unmet_production')
RAW_FLOW_FIELDS=('imports','exports','purchases','sales','opening_stock','produced','stock','unmet_production')


def nonnegative_integer(value,label):
    assert type(value) is int and value>=0,(label,value)


def validate_raw_summary(result):
    countries=result['countries'];world=result['world']
    assert 'raw_policy' in world and set(world['raw_policy'])=={'machine_credits','starter'}
    assert world['raw_policy'] in [asdict(policy) for policy in MODES.values()]
    for name,x in countries.items():
        for key in RAW_COUNTRY_SCALARS:
            assert key in x,('missing raw country scalar',name,key)
            numeric(x[key],(name,key))
        for key in RAW_MAPS:
            assert key in x and set(x[key])==set(RAW_GOODS),(name,key,'missing raw map')
            for good,value in x[key].items():nonnegative_integer(value,(name,key,good))
        assert 'raw_use' in x and set(x['raw_use'])==set(RAW_GOODS),(name,'raw_use')
        for good,counts in x['raw_use'].items():
            assert set(counts)==set(RAW_COUNTS),(name,good,'raw source fields')
            for key,value in counts.items():nonnegative_integer(value,(name,good,key))
            assert counts['consumed']==counts['production']+counts['research']==sum(counts[k] for k in SOURCE_KINDS)
            assert counts['imported_used']<=counts['consumed']
            assert counts['production']==x['production_raw'][good] and counts['research']==x['research_raw'][good]
            assert x['raw_importing'][good] in (0,1)
            assert 0<=x['raw_import_rounds'][good]<=9
            assert 1<=x['first_raw_import_round'][good]<=10
            assert (x['first_raw_import_round'][good]==10)==(x['raw_importing'][good]==0)
            assert bool(x['raw_import_rounds'][good])==bool(x['raw_importing'][good])
        assert 0<=x['first_round_happy']<=100 and 0<=x['first_two_happy']<=100
        assert 0<=x['first_two_food_short']<=2
        assert x['first_round_production_failures']<=x['first_two_production_failures']
        for good in ('machine','electronics'):
            assert x[good+'_g2'] in (0,1) and x[good+'_g3'] in (0,1)
            assert x[good+'_g3']<=x[good+'_g2']
        assert math.isclose(x['end_asset_value'],x['cash_plus_stock_value']+.45*x['investment'],abs_tol=1e-9)
    for key in RAW_WORLD_SUMS:
        assert key in world,('missing raw world scalar',key)
        numeric(world[key],('world',key))
        assert world[key]==sum(x[key] for x in countries.values()),('world sum',key)
    for key in RAW_WORLD_MAPS:
        assert key in world and set(world[key])==set(RAW_GOODS),('world',key)
        for good in RAW_GOODS:
            nonnegative_integer(world[key][good],('world',key,good))
            assert world[key][good]==sum(x[key][good] for x in countries.values())
    assert 'raw_use' in world and set(world['raw_use'])==set(RAW_GOODS)
    for good in RAW_GOODS:
        assert set(world['raw_use'][good])==set(RAW_COUNTS)
        for key in RAW_COUNTS:
            assert world['raw_use'][good][key]==sum(x['raw_use'][good][key] for x in countries.values())
        assert world['initial_raw_left'][good]<=world['starter_raw'][good]
    for key in ('first_round_happy','first_two_happy'):
        assert key in world
        numeric(world[key],('world',key))
        assert math.isclose(world[key],statistics.mean(x[key] for x in countries.values()),abs_tol=1e-9)
    for key,field in (('initial_asset_value','start_asset_value'),('end_asset_value','end_asset_value')):
        assert key in world
        numeric(world[key],('world',key))
        assert math.isclose(world[key],sum(x[field] for x in countries.values()),abs_tol=1e-9)
    return result


def validate_raw_ledger(game,result):
    rows=game.raw_round_ledger
    expected={(name,r) for name in game.cs for r in range(1,10)}
    cells=[(row['country'],row['round']) for row in rows]
    assert len(rows)==81 and set(cells)==expected
    cash={(row['country'],row['round']):row for row in game.cash_ledger}
    assert set(cash)==expected and len(game.cash_ledger)==81
    previous={(name,g):game.starter_allocation[name][g] for name in game.cs for g in RAW_GOODS}
    by_country=defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        name,r=row['country'],row['round'];by_country[name].append(row)
        assert row['cash']==cash[(name,r)]['cash_end'] and row['happy']==cash[(name,r)]['happy']
        assert type(row['food_met']) is bool
        assert set(row['goods'])==set(RAW_GOODS)
        for good,x in row['goods'].items():
            assert set(x)==set(RAW_COUNTS+RAW_FLOW_FIELDS)|{'machine_credits_by_grade'}
            for key in RAW_COUNTS+RAW_FLOW_FIELDS:nonnegative_integer(x[key],(name,r,good,key))
            assert x['opening_stock']==previous[(name,good)]
            assert x['stock']==x['opening_stock']+x['produced']+x['imports']-x['exports']-x['consumed']
            previous[(name,good)]=x['stock']
            assert x['consumed']==x['production']+x['research']==sum(x[k] for k in SOURCE_KINDS)
            assert x['imported_used']<=x['consumed']
            assert x['purchases']==cash[(name,r)]['purchase_by_good'][good]
            assert x['sales']==cash[(name,r)]['sale_by_good'][good]
            assert set(x['machine_credits_by_grade'])=={'1','2','3'}
            for value in x['machine_credits_by_grade'].values():
                assert type(value) is int and 0<=value<game.raw_policy.machine_credits
    for name,selected in by_country.items():
        assert [row['round'] for row in selected]==list(range(1,10))
        x=result['countries'][name]
        assert x['first_round_happy']==selected[0]['happy']
        assert x['first_two_happy']==statistics.mean(row['happy'] for row in selected[:2])
        assert x['first_two_food_short']==sum(not row['food_met'] for row in selected[:2])
        assert x['first_round_production_failures']==selected[0]['production_failures']
        assert x['first_two_production_failures']==sum(row['production_failures'] for row in selected[:2])
        for good in RAW_GOODS:
            assert previous[(name,good)]==x['end_stock_by_good'][good]
            for key in RAW_COUNTS:
                assert sum(row['goods'][good][key] for row in selected)==x['raw_use'][good][key]
            for key,summary_key in (('imports','import_goods'),('exports','export_goods'),('purchases','purchase_by_good'),('sales','sale_by_good')):
                assert sum(row['goods'][good][key] for row in selected)==x[summary_key][good]
            assert sum(row['goods'][good]['unmet_production'] for row in selected)==x['raw_unmet_production'][good]
    for r in range(1,10):
        selected=[row for row in rows if row['round']==r]
        for good in RAW_GOODS:
            assert sum(row['goods'][good]['imports'] for row in selected)==sum(row['goods'][good]['exports'] for row in selected)
            assert sum(row['goods'][good]['purchases'] for row in selected)==sum(row['goods'][good]['sales'] for row in selected)


def hashes(files):
    return {name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files}


def numeric(value,label):
    assert type(value) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(value),(label,value)


def count_map(obj,key,allowed):
    """Only sparse, documented count maps get explicit zero entries.

    A missing map, misspelled good, or missing mandatory scalar is an error.
    """
    assert key in obj and isinstance(obj[key],dict),('missing count map',key)
    assert set(obj[key])<=set(allowed),('unknown count key',key,set(obj[key])-set(allowed))
    for good,value in obj[key].items():
        numeric(value,(key,good))
        assert value>=0,(key,good,value)
    obj[key]={good:obj[key].get(good,0) for good in allowed}


def normalize_and_validate(result):
    assert isinstance(result.get('countries'),dict) and isinstance(result.get('world'),dict)
    assert set(result['countries'])==set(CONFIG)|set(ADDITIONS)
    for name,x in result['countries'].items():
        for key in REQUIRED_COUNTRY+ADVICE_REQUIRED_COUNTRY:
            assert key in x,('missing required country scalar',name,key)
            numeric(x[key],(name,key))
        for key in COUNTRY_GOOD_COUNTS:count_map(x,key,GOODS)
        assert 'listed_by_good' in x and set(x['listed_by_good'])==set(GOODS),(name,'listed_by_good')
        for good,value in x['listed_by_good'].items():
            numeric(value,(name,'listed_by_good',good))
            assert value>=0
        assert sum(x['listed_by_good'].values())==x['listed'],(name,'listed inventory reconciliation')
        assert 'channel_stats' in x and set(x['channel_stats'])==set(CHANNELS),(name,'channel_stats')
        for channel,values in x['channel_stats'].items():
            assert set(values)==set(CHANNEL_FIELDS),(name,channel,'channel fields')
            for key,value in values.items():
                numeric(value,(name,channel,key))
                assert value>=0
        for channel_key,total_key in (('sold_units','exports'),('bought_units','imports'),
                                      ('sales_cash','revenue'),('purchase_cash','purchases')):
            assert sum(c[channel_key] for c in x['channel_stats'].values())==x[total_key],(name,channel_key)
        assert x['channel_stats']['barter']['sales_cash']==x['channel_stats']['barter']['purchase_cash']==0
        assert x['all_goods_unique_used']==sum(x['use_by_good'].values()),(name,'unique use reconciliation')
        assert x['planning_holds']<=x['planning_decisions'],(name,'planning holds')
        assert x['economic_at_cap'] in (0,1),(name,'economic_at_cap')
        for key in ('production_raw','research_raw'):count_map(x,key,('ore','fuel'))
        # An absent industry is Lv.0; this is structural absence, not imputation.
        count_map(x,'end_levels',GOODS)
        for key in ('machine_stock_by_gen','machine_produced_by_gen'):
            assert set(x[key])=={'1','2','3'},(name,key)
            for gen,value in x[key].items():numeric(value,(name,key,gen))
        assert set(x['needs_by_good'])==set(GOODS),(name,'needs_by_good')
        for good,need in x['needs_by_good'].items():
            for key in ('external','fulfilled'):numeric(need[key],(name,good,key))
            assert 0<=need['fulfilled']<=need['external']
        if name in NAMES:
            for key in ('score','economic','industry','trade'):numeric(x[key],(name,key))
            assert 'industry_capacity_score' in x,('missing industry capacity',name)
            numeric(x['industry_capacity_score'],(name,'industry_capacity_score'))
            assert math.isclose(x['industry_capacity_score']+x['industry_use_score'],x['industry'],abs_tol=1e-9)
        else:
            assert x['score'] is None and x['economic'] is None and x['industry'] is None
            assert 'industry_capacity_score' in x and x['industry_capacity_score'] is None,(name,'diagnostic scores unavailable')
    world=result['world']
    for key in REQUIRED_WORLD+ADVICE_REQUIRED_WORLD:
        assert key in world,('missing required world scalar',key)
        numeric(world[key],('world',key))
    for key in WORLD_GOOD_COUNTS:count_map(world,key,GOODS)
    for key in ADVICE_REQUIRED_WORLD:
        assert world[key]==sum(x[key] for x in result['countries'].values()),('world total',key)
    assert sum(x['exports'] for x in result['countries'].values())==world['trade_units']
    assert sum(x['imports'] for x in result['countries'].values())==world['trade_units']
    for channel in CHANNELS:
        assert sum(x['channel_stats'][channel]['sales_cash'] for x in result['countries'].values())==sum(
            x['channel_stats'][channel]['purchase_cash'] for x in result['countries'].values()),('channel cash balance',channel)
    assert set(world['end_prices'])==set(GOODS)
    assert set(world['machine_launch_rounds'])=={'2','3'}
    for key,value in world['end_prices'].items():numeric(value,('price',key))
    for key,value in world['machine_launch_rounds'].items():
        assert type(value) is int and 1<=value<=10,('launch round',key,value)
    assert world['countries']==9
    return validate_raw_summary(result)


def build_tasks(n=200,stress_n=30):
    tasks=[('main',mode,seed,None,'normal') for mode in MODES for seed in range(54000,54000+n)]
    tasks += [('stress',mode,seed,focal,style) for mode in STRESS_MODES
              for focal,style in STRESS_SCENARIOS for seed in range(56000,56000+stress_n)]
    assert len(tasks)==len(set(tasks))
    return tasks


def trace_key(record):
    return ':'.join(str(record[k]) for k in ('phase','mode','seed','focal','style'))


def run_one(task):
    phase,mode,seed,focal,style=task
    game=Game(seed,variant=mode,focal=focal,style='normal' if style=='no_trade' else style,
              trade_enabled=style!='no_trade')
    result=normalize_and_validate(game.run())
    assert result['world']['raw_policy']==asdict(MODES[mode])
    for key in ('offer_price_mismatches','listing_plan_violations','protected_offer_violations','uncovered_investments'):
        assert result['world'][key]==0,(mode,seed,focal,style,key)
    if style in REFUSAL_STYLES:
        actor=result['countries'][focal]
        for good in REFUSAL_STYLES[style]:
            assert actor['import_goods'][good]==actor['purchase_by_good'][good]==actor['raw_use'][good]['imported_used']==0
    validate_raw_ledger(game,result)
    record={'phase':phase,'mode':mode,'seed':seed,'focal':focal,'style':style,**result}
    cash_ledger=game.cash_ledger if phase=='main' else None
    raw_ledger=game.raw_round_ledger if phase=='main' else None
    representative=(phase=='main' and seed==54000) or (phase=='stress' and seed==56000 and style in REFUSAL_STYLES)
    trace={**game.trace(),**{k:record[k] for k in ('phase','mode','seed','focal','style')}} if representative else None
    return record,cash_ledger,raw_ledger,trace


def flat(obj,prefix=''):
    result={}
    for key,value in obj.items():
        path=f'{prefix}.{key}' if prefix else key
        if isinstance(value,dict):result.update(flat(value,path))
        elif type(value) in (int,float):
            numeric(value,path)
            result[path]=value
    return result


def stats(values):
    assert values
    mean=statistics.mean(values)
    error=statistics.stdev(values)/math.sqrt(len(values)) if len(values)>1 else 0
    return {'n':len(values),'mean':mean,'ci95':[mean-1.96*error,mean+1.96*error],
            'min':min(values),'max':max(values)}


def grouped(rows):
    flattened=[flat({'countries':row['countries'],'world':row['world']}) for row in rows]
    keys=set(flattened[0])
    for row in flattened:assert set(row)==keys,'inconsistent numeric schema; do not silently drop metrics'
    return {'n':len(rows),'metrics':{key:stats([row[key] for row in flattened]) for key in sorted(keys)}}


def pair(a,b,focal=None):
    left={row['seed']:flat({'countries':row['countries'],'world':row['world']}) for row in a}
    right={row['seed']:flat({'countries':row['countries'],'world':row['world']}) for row in b}
    assert len(left)==len(a) and len(right)==len(b) and left.keys()==right.keys()
    seeds=sorted(left)
    keys=set(left[seeds[0]])
    for seed in seeds:
        assert set(left[seed])==keys and set(right[seed])==keys,'paired metric schemas differ'
    result={key:stats([right[seed][key]-left[seed][key] for seed in seeds]) for key in sorted(keys)}
    if focal in NAMES:
        result['world.other_original_five_happy']=stats([
            statistics.mean(right[seed][f'countries.{name}.happy']-left[seed][f'countries.{name}.happy']
                            for name in NAMES if name!=focal) for seed in seeds])
    return result


def summarize(rows,metadata):
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:groups[(row['phase'],row['mode'],row['focal'],row['style'])].append(row)
    experiments={':'.join(map(str,key)):grouped(group) for key,group in groups.items()}
    pairs={}
    for a,b in MAIN_PAIRS:
        pairs[f'main:{a}->{b}']=pair(groups[('main',a,None,'normal')],groups[('main',b,None,'normal')])
    for mode in STRESS_MODES:
        control=groups[('stress',mode,None,'normal')]
        for focal,style in STRESS_SCENARIOS:
            if style=='normal':continue
            suffix='no_trade' if style=='no_trade' else f'{focal}:{style}'
            pairs[f'stress:{mode}:{suffix}']=pair(control,groups[('stress',mode,focal,style)],focal)
    for a,b in STRESS_PAIRS:
        for focal,style in STRESS_SCENARIOS:
            pairs[f'stress:{a}->{b}:{focal}:{style}']=pair(
                groups[('stress',a,focal,style)],groups[('stress',b,focal,style)],focal)
    return {'metadata':metadata,'experiments':experiments,'paired':pairs}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--n',type=int,default=200)
    parser.add_argument('--stress-n',type=int,default=30)
    parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=4)
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,default=OUT)
    parser.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if not 2<=args.n<=2000 or not 2<=args.stress_n<=2000:
        parser.error('use 2..2000 seeds per group without overlapping designated seed bands')
    if args.workers<1:parser.error('workers must be positive')
    tasks=build_tasks(args.n,args.stress_n)
    sources=hashes(SOURCE_FILES)
    tests=hashes(TEST_FILES)
    if args.dry_run:
        print(json.dumps({'planned_games':len(tasks),'main_games':len(MODES)*args.n,
            'stress_games':len(STRESS_MODES)*len(STRESS_SCENARIOS)*args.stress_n,

            'stress_seed_range':[56000,56000+args.stress_n-1],

            'stress_between_mode_pairs':len(STRESS_PAIRS)*len(STRESS_SCENARIOS),
            'representative_traces':len(MODES)+len(STRESS_MODES)*9,'executed_games':0},ensure_ascii=False))
        return
    output=args.output_dir.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name in ('pre_run_plan.json','run_manifest.json','summary.json','runs.jsonl.gz',
                 'runs.partial.jsonl.gz','round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','round_ledgers.jsonl.gz',
                 'raw_round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','raw_round_ledgers.jsonl.gz','first_seed_traces.json.gz'):
        if (output/name).exists():raise FileExistsError(f'Preserve existing validation output; choose a new --output-dir: {output/name}')
    assert ADVICE_SCHEMA_READY,'recommendation summary contract has not been frozen'
    test_manifest_path=ROOT/'raw_results'/'tests_manifest.json'
    test_manifest=json.loads(test_manifest_path.read_text())
    assert test_manifest['passed'] is True and test_manifest['test_count']>197
    assert test_manifest['inherited_tests']==197
    assert test_manifest['test_sha256']==tests,'tests changed after recorded verification'
    assert test_manifest['economic_source_sha256']==hashes(ECONOMIC_FILES),'economic source changed after recorded tests'
    assert test_manifest['validation_source_sha256']==sources,'runner/source changed after recorded verification'
    config={'main_seed_range':[54000,54000+args.n-1],
        'stress_seed_range':[56000,56000+args.stress_n-1],'excluded_pilot_range':[52000,52029],
        'excluded_test_seed_band':[52100,52199],
        'planned_games':len(tasks),'modes':{name:asdict(policy) for name,policy in MODES.items()},
        'raw_modes':{name:asdict(policy) for name,policy in MODES.items()},'advice_mode':'price',
        'baseline_reference':'v7 price unchanged',
        'physical_mode':'coupled','physical_policy':asdict(PHYSICAL_MODES['coupled']),
        'baseline_ai_policy':asdict(POLICIES['balanced']),'options':asdict(BASE_OPTIONS),
        'legacy_credits_per_raw':CREDITS_PER_RAW,'upkeep_uses':UPKEEP_USES,
        'original_countries':CONFIG,'new_countries':ADDITIONS,'rounds':9,'countries':9,'main_ledger_rows_planned':len(MODES)*args.n*81,
        'representative_traces_planned':len(MODES)+len(STRESS_MODES)*9,
        'source_sha256':sources,'source_sha256_before':sources,'test_sha256_before':tests,
        'tests_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(test_manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'tests_completed':test_manifest['test_count'],
        'advice_required_country':ADVICE_REQUIRED_COUNTRY,'advice_required_world':ADVICE_REQUIRED_WORLD,
        'channels':CHANNELS,'channel_fields':CHANNEL_FIELDS,
        'stress_modes':STRESS_MODES,
        'stress_scenarios':STRESS_SCENARIOS,'main_pairs':MAIN_PAIRS,'stress_mode_pairs':STRESS_PAIRS,
        'normalization':'Only documented sparse goods counts and absent industry levels receive zero; missing mandatory fields fail.',
        'primary_checks':['cash/goods/ownership/escrow and material credit conservation',
            'zero uncovered investments under inherited balanced policy',
            'advice-to-final-price and public-listing-volume consistency',

            'all-goods actual production/use/inventory and trade channels',
            'raw source classes, raw mass balance, first two rounds and scoped machine credits',

        'limitations':['serial rule-based agents, not a multiplayer app or student study',

         gzip.open(output/'raw_round_ledgers.partial.jsonl.gz','wt') as raw_ledger_file:
        for i,(record,ledger,raw_ledger,trace) in enumerate(pool.map(run_one,tasks,chunksize=4),1):

    assert len(rows)==len(tasks)==len({(r['phase'],r['mode'],r['seed'],r['focal'],r['style']) for r in rows})
    after=hashes(SOURCE_FILES)
    tests_after=hashes(TEST_FILES)
    assert sources==after,'source changed during formal execution'
    assert tests==tests_after,'test definitions changed during formal execution'
